intendedAudience: Visitors deciding whether to begin with a source-bound Google Search status guide or use a worksheet after recording their own-site evidence.
decision: Choose the next source-bound resource without treating either resource as a report of current Google Search status, a diagnosis, or a causal explanation for a site change.

metadata.title: Should I start with the Google Search guide or the evidence worksheet?
metadata.description: A source-bound decision aid for choosing between the Google Search status guide and the own-site evidence worksheet without stating current status or cause.

sourceBindings.purpose: Direct visitors to inspect the official Google Search Status source at their own decision time.

routeBindings.purpose: Existing published guide for choosing what to inspect before a visitor has dated own-site evidence.
Existing worksheet route fact for comparing a decision-time observation with separately recorded own-site evidence.

decisionAids.choiceCriteria: Choose the guide first before you have dated own-site evidence and need to decide what to inspect.
decisionAids.result: The guide separates direct official-status checking, controlled historical context, and your own-site evidence.

decisionAids.choiceCriteria: Choose the worksheet after you have dated own-site evidence to record separately from a decision-time official-status observation.
decisionAids.result: The worksheet preserves an unknown conclusion unless independently reviewed evidence establishes a connection.

boundaries.currentOfficialStatus: Check Google Search Status directly at decision time; this discovery contract does not state a current status or incident.
boundaries.noCausation: This discovery contract does not diagnose a site change and does not establish cause from a status observation or either linked resource.
unknowns: Whether a visitor's own-site change is connected to an official-status observation remains unknown without independently reviewed evidence.
This contract does not determine a current incident, ranking effect, traffic outcome, or remediation.
boundaries.privacyAndMeasurement: Neither decision aid collects, transmits, or retains visitor or site evidence; this contract does not measure users, traffic, demand, conversion, willingness to pay, revenue, or another commercial outcome.

faqs.question: When should I choose the guide?
faqs.answer: Choose the guide before you have dated own-site evidence and need to decide what to inspect first.

faqs.question: When should I choose the worksheet?
faqs.answer: Choose the worksheet after you have dated own-site evidence to keep it separate from a decision-time official-status observation.

correctionAndCurrentnessPolicy: Check the official source directly at decision time and make a correction to any discovery copy that misstates an admitted route, source, or boundary; do not turn historical route facts into current incident evidence.

publication.coordinatorDependency: The coordinator-owned shared static route adapter remains the public-route owner; release and public verification are recorded only from coordinator-provided accepted release evidence.
